name: fill_word_table_range
description: Loops over an inclusive index range and stores into each slot of a word table the value returned by a routine call. The table is addressed relative to a fixed base offset from the frame register.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9072
name: rotate_word_table_range
description: Shifts a range of words in a table by one slot, moving the last word to the front when the mode is one and the first word to the back when the mode is two. The table base is then passed to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9098
name: shift_words_up_insert
description: Moves words in the table one slot toward higher indexes until the lower bound is reached, then writes a saved word into the bound slot. The table base is then passed to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:90CE
name: rotate_left_or_copy_range
description: When the mode argument is two, rotates a word range left by one slot so the first word moves to the end; otherwise it copies the range from a second table. The table base is then passed to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:90EC
name: shift_word_range_left
description: Moves each word in a range one slot toward lower indexes and stores the input word in the top slot of the range. The table base is then passed to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9122
name: copy_word_range_from_buffer
description: Copies words from a second buffer into the table over an index range taken from two global fields. The table base is then passed to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9128
name: copy_word_table_range
description: Copies words from a second buffer into the table from a starting index through an upper bound inclusive. The table base is then passed to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:915E
name: open_database_and_load_table
description: Clears 255 thirty-byte records and resets two counters, then opens the named database file through the dos read path. On success it reads a two-word size header and the table data that follows; on failure it sets an error flag and reports that the database could not be opened.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:92D2
name: clear_records_and_release_handle
description: Clears the same 255 thirty-byte records, then if a stored file handle is positive it passes that handle to a routine and marks the handle as unused.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9362
name: split_words_into_four_planes
description: Reads four consecutive words at a time from a source buffer and writes each one to a different destination area, with the areas spaced evenly apart. This splits interleaved word data into four separate planes.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:942E
name: read_name_find_record
description: Reads a run of bytes from a source into a buffer, then scans up to 255 records of the table and returns the index of the first one for which the comparison routine returns zero, or minus one if none matches.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:94AE
name: seek_and_read_record_data
description: Uses a record selected by its first argument to seek in the open file to an offset stored in that record, then reads a block whose length is also stored in the record into the buffer given by the second argument. The call sites show the read and seek wrappers are used.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9508
name: copy_bytes_and_advance_source
description: Copies a given number of bytes from the buffer whose pointer is held in the first argument into the destination, then stores the advanced source pointer back. The pseudo-code shows a simple byte loop with no other side effects.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:953E
name: allocate_animation_frames
description: Looks up a record and, when found, swaps two screen buffers that sit 32000 bytes apart before loading its frames. For each frame it requests a free slot and stores the record index and frame number there; if no slot is free it reports an allocation failure and returns zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9802
name: remap_three_nibbles
description: Returns zero for a zero input; otherwise it transforms each of the three low nibbles of the word by computing twice the nibble plus one and keeping the low four bits, then repacks the three results into one word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9868
name: read_record_color_table
description: Looks up a record and, when found, swaps two screen buffers 32000 bytes apart, copies a 32-byte block, and reads sixteen words into the 16-word table, returning one. The 16-word size matches a 16-entry colour table.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9A54
name: load_record_name_by_extension
description: Looks up a record for a file name and, when the name contains a dot extension, copies a 32-byte name block into the record at an offset chosen by whether the extension starts with N. It returns one when an extension is present and zero otherwise.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9A78
name: copy_name_by_extension
description: Scans a file name for a dot and, if a valid extension follows, copies a 32-byte name block at an offset chosen by whether the extension starts with N, otherwise copying a two-byte value first. It returns one on success and zero when no extension is found.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9B86
name: copy_name_block_by_extension
description: Checks the name passed in for a dot extension and copies the name block into the data area, with the target offset depending on whether the extension starts with N. It returns one when the extension is present.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9BBC
name: check_dot_extension_and_copy
description: Checks whether the character at a given index is a dot followed by a character still inside the name length, and if so copies an extension block, choosing the offset by whether the next character is N. It returns one for a match and zero otherwise.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9C0E
name: copy_word_and_name_block
description: Copies a two-byte value and then a 32-byte name block into the record buffers, sets the data pointer past the fixed header, and returns one. It is the non-N branch of the extension copy.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9C4A
name: return_zero_stub
description: Takes no action and returns zero, so callers always see the failure result.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9C50
name: read_sized_block_from_file
description: Opens the named file, reads two short values from it, and reads a block whose length is their product into the buffer given as the second argument before releasing the handle.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9CC8
name: decompress_backwards_bit_stream
description: Decodes a packed stream by filling the output buffer from its end, alternating between copying a run from earlier output and writing literal bytes read through a bit reader, until the start of the buffer is reached.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D76
name: shift_bit_buffer_with_refill
description: Shifts a 32-bit bit buffer right one bit at a time for a count taken from a register, loading the next word from memory whenever the buffer runs empty. It feeds the bit reader used by the unpacker.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D98
name: load_slot_table_from_file
description: Releases any non-zero slots in a 50-entry table, then opens the named file and reads an entry count and entry list into the slots. A separate path runs when the file cannot be opened, and both paths fill each slot with values read or derived from the data.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A22C
name: read_entries_skipping_marked
description: Looks up a file record and reads a count-prefixed list of entries. For each entry marked with the skip value it advances the file offset by the stored size, and for every other entry it reads that many bytes into the entry's 32-byte slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A49A
name: load_twelve_byte_entry_table
description: Clears a 255-entry table of 12-byte records, then looks up the named record and reads a count followed by four words per entry into the table. It then reads a data block for each entry whose first word is non-zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A844
name: load_six_byte_index_table
description: Clears a 255-entry table of six-byte records, then looks up the named record and reads a count followed by word values into the table. It then reads a data block for each entry whose first word is non-zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:ABC6
name: process_four_flagged_entries
description: Checks four flag bytes in the global area and, for each set flag, calls a sequence of routines with offsets computed from the same base and a different constant for each entry.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:ACBE
name: reset_all_game_state_tables
description: Clears the entry tables, the 32-byte record table, the 16-word table and several scalar variables, then calls routines that reset named records. The file name AUTO00.PRC is referenced by the same routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:B77C
name: load_directory_table_from_file
description: Opens the LVDT.DIR file and, if it can be read, reads up to 200 bytes of directory data into a table, closes it, and returns one. If the file cannot be opened it fills ten 20-byte entries with a default string and returns zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:B82A
name: read_directory_block
description: Reads a 200-byte block from the open file handle into the directory table, closes the handle, and returns one.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:B942
name: load_backup_game_state
description: Opens the named backup file and, if it cannot be found, reports that the backup does not exist and returns minus one. Otherwise it clears the game state tables and reads each saved field from the file in turn with its size.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:B9D4
name: read_game_state_from_file
description: Clears the entry tables, the word tables and several scalar variables, then reads a long sequence of game state fields from the open file into fixed buffers, each with its own byte count.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:BFEE
name: read_three_pass_entry_block
description: Reads a counted block of entries from the file in three passes, each pass reading a count-driven number of records, then calls a routine for each non-zero flag in the global area and returns zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C022
name: read_counted_entries_and_flags
description: Reads a counted block of entries from the file in two passes, then calls routines for each non-zero flag in the global area and returns zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C056
name: read_entries_with_flag_calls
description: Reads a counted block of entries from the file and then calls a routine for each non-zero flag in the global area, returning zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C08A
name: read_single_pass_entry_block
description: Reads one counted block of entries from the file and runs the same flag-gated routine calls on the result, returning zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C1DA
name: allocate_and_link_record_node

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C1DE
name: allocate_linked_record_from_list
description: Walks a linked list to its tail, allocates a new node of fixed size and links it there, then reads five fields into the node, including two 100-byte blocks and a slot index whose table value it stores in the node.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C1E2
name: allocate_linked_record_at_tail
description: Walks a list to its tail, allocates a fixed-size node and links it, then reads five fields into it, including two 100-byte blocks, and stores the table value selected by a slot index in the node.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C216
name: read_and_link_buffer_chain
description: Allocates a fixed-size buffer, links it into a list, reads two 100-byte blocks and three 2-byte values into it through the read wrapper, and stores the table entry selected by the last value.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C2E2
name: refresh_record_table_links
description: Walks the record list and, for each node, stores into it the table entry selected by the index field already held in that node.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C31A
name: allocate_record_node_second_list
description: Allocates a fixed-size node, links it at the tail of a second list, reads five fields into it, and stores the 12-byte table entry selected by the last field.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C34E
name: read_link_buffer_chain_alt
description: Allocates a fixed-size buffer, links it into a list, reads two 100-byte blocks and three 2-byte values through the read wrapper, and stores the 12-byte table entry selected by the last value.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C41A
name: refresh_second_list_entries
description: Walks the second record list and, for each node, stores into it the 12-byte table entry selected by the index field already held in that node.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return, so calling it has no effect.

name: allocate_and_read_small_node
description: Allocates a 20-byte node, reads 20 bytes from the open file into it, and links it at the tail of the list.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C482
name: read_link_small_buffer
description: Allocates a 20-byte buffer, reads 20 bytes into it through the read wrapper, then links the buffer into a global list using a global variable as the base.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C4F4
name: allocate_small_node_second_list
description: Allocates a 20-byte node, fills it from the input, and links it at the tail of a second list.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C524
name: read_link_buffer_second
description: Allocates a 20-byte buffer, reads 20 bytes into it through the read wrapper, and links it into a second global list using that list's base.

name: read_entry_blocks_for_records

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C678
name: read_entry_blocks_with_offsets

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C7A2

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C7DA
name: read_entry_blocks_second_pass
description: Runs a second pass over the 26-byte entry table, reading record blocks for entries that share the current record index.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C89E

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C950

description: Walks a node list and calls a routine for each node whose table entry is active, with arguments taken from the node's fields and the entry's size, and stops when the list ends.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:C9A8

description: Walks a node list and applies the same entry-table routine calls to each node, with the call form depending on whether the node's second field is zero. It stops when the list ends.

name: no_op_return_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:CB5C

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:CBDA
name: setup_blitter_and_wait
description: Waits for the raster line, then sets raster and blitter parameters using two screen buffers offset by 32000 bytes and performs a single blit between them.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:CC76
name: draw_text_lines_centered
description: Measures a bar-separated text block to find its longest line, sizes and centers a box for it, then draws each character by copying glyph rows from a font table into both screen buffers.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:CCBC
name: draw_text_block_words

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:CCC2
name: draw_text_block_frame
